ValidationRule.description: Prohibits a Credit Review from being changed to Status EP Review Done if Credit Processor on Opportunity is null. Only applies to outsource processors.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISBLANK(Opportunity__r.Credit_Processor__c) && ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'EP Review Done') && $Profile.Name = 'NF - Outsource Processor - WC'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Credit Processor field on the Opportunity must be entered before you can Complete Processing. You may need to refresh the page to enable the Complete Processing button.
